verdict.rationale: Martin is a SaaS personal assistant that could plausibly ship developer SDKs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only end-user integrations (calendar, inbox, Slack) and interfaces (email, SMS, Slack). No official SDK or public API is documented, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
